og:type \"%1$s\" doesn\'t change the layout. Only rich, video, video.* and instapp:photo do.
twitter:card \"%1$s\" doesn\'t change the layout. Only player, summary_large_image and photo do.

theme-color \"%1$s\" is ignored. Discord accepts #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA only.
Timestamp from %1$s
%1$s \"%2$s\" is ignored. Use a full RFC 3339 timestamp with a time and an offset.

Image dimensions follow og:image:url / secure_url / twitter:image:src. They only attach to plain og:image and twitter:image.
